title: Weird words are growing
author: film-cards
hypothesis: Weird-word titles are a bigger share of stories in the latest 12 months than before.
expect: Share of stories in the latest 12 months divided by the pooled share of all earlier stories since 2006: at least 1.1x supports (1.3x or more is strong); at or below 0.9x refutes. Between is inconclusive. Title matching only.

check.per_label: weird and mysterious words share of stories

thresholds_note: Exploratory. Thresholds copied from the card this one replaces.
caveats: Title matching only: the word list is in scripts/film.py and will miss and mis-match some stories.
Archive scores and comment counts for recent stories are low for all stories, so only ratios against the same months are used.
Associations do not show what causes attention.
